name: Triple Tech Cost
description: Every technology level on the Tech screen costs 3 times its normal price, in tech points: Farming level 2 6,000 -> 18,000, level 3 50,000 -> 150,000; Fertility level 2 11,000 -> 33,000, level 3 240,000 -> 720,000; Science level 2 12,000 -> 36,000, level 3 150,000 -> 450,000; Medicine level 2 15,000 -> 45,000, level 3 250,000 -> 750,000; Construction level 2 2,500 -> 7,500, level 3 80,000 -> 240,000; Spirituality level 2 5,000 -> 15,000, level 3 80,000 -> 240,000. The Tech screen shows the tripled price, a purchase is refused (and nothing is spent) with fewer tech points than that, and buying takes exactly that many. Research, tech points from anywhere else, every other tech-point cost (such as clothes) and the patcher's own upgrades are unchanged. **Needs no other patch.** Makes the game super hard.
behavior_changes: Every technology price immediate in the Tech screen's hover label (0x434070), information box (0x4345E0) and buy handler (0x435AEF), each a price immediate, x 3: the shown price, the buy handler's refusal threshold (cmp / jb: too few tech points shows the game's message and spends nothing) and the amount it takes (sub) are the same tripled number.
explicit_non_changes: Each price is changed in place, same length; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.

Research, tech points from island events and duplicate collectibles, every other tech-point cost (such as 5,000 for clothes) and the patcher's Origins and Story / Cheat upgrades keep their stock numbers.
